#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The backup destination is supplied at runtime (for example via DEST=host:/backups
# or as the first argument). It is deliberately not hard-coded in this repo.
DEST="${1:-${DEST:-}}"
if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup destination is not set (pass it as an argument or DEST env var)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        # Remote destination (host:path).
        scp -p "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
    *)
        # Local destination (mount point or directory).
        cp -p "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
